The compilation error stems from the removal of org.cactoos.collection.CollectionOf in cactoos 0.55.0. Previously, CollectionOf was used to get the size of an Iterable. In the new API, this functionality is provided by org.cactoos.scalar.LengthOf with a constructor accepting an Iterable. To fix the client code:
- Replace the import of CollectionOf with LengthOf.
- Replace usages of new CollectionOf<>(iterable).size() with new LengthOf(iterable).intValue().
These minimal changes maintain functionality while adapting to the new API.
